Hi,

I'm Bartek, founder of Watchgoose.

Watchgoose monitors cron jobs, backups, scheduled tasks, and recurring
workflows that can signal their status. It's Europe hosted, operated & owned.

I'd like to give BlinkDisk project a needs matched paid plan, free, for as long as the
project is eligible via our Open Source support initiative:
https://watchgoose.com/open-source/

FreeBSD.org, Rclone.org and FreshBSD.org already participate by offering Watchgoose
as a benefit to its committers and/or using it for monitoring of their infrastructure.

Obviously any acknowledgment through your normal process is absoltely optional and
never a condition for the donation.

Let me know if you'd be interested or have any questions about it.

Kind regards,
Bartek Rutkowski
